row.name: hermes-console
row.description: Console is a private, native Android app for your self-hosted Hermes Agent: chat that shows the agent's work, voice, bots and rooms, cron, tasks, models and an SSH terminal. One code to connect. No account, no telemetry. GPL-3.0.
